properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party Poly1305 one-time MAC (RFC 8439 §2.5) implemented in src/poly1305.rs (clamped r key, 32-byte key, 16-byte tag) and publicly exported via lib.rs:42. It is the authenticator inside the crate's ChaCha20-Poly1305 AEAD: chacha20poly1305.rs:33-37 derives the one-time MAC key by encrypting 64 zero bytes with ChaCha20. Sites at chacha20poly1305.rs:110/125/749-788 are test-vector/bench invocations of the live construction. Symmetric MAC, quantum-safe in practice.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: First-party bcrypt password hashing: pub fn bcrypt at src/bcrypt.rs:22 — cost is the 2^cost exponent on Blowfish key expansion (asserted < 32), 16-byte salt, 24-byte output, built on the crate's own Blowfish (src/blowfish.rs). Exported at lib.rs:21. The two detected file sites (bcrypt.rs:144, 161) are #[cfg(test)]/bench invocations using Openwall's published vectors at cost 5; the implementation itself is live, caller-supplied cost. Quantum-safe (symmetric, memory-CPU-hard by parameter choice).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The crate's own SHA-256 (src/sha2.rs, FIPS 180-4), publicly exported, and used internally by real first-party crypto: Fortuna CSPRNG reseeding (fortuna.rs:102, key = SHA-256d(key||seed)), scrypt's HMAC-SHA256 core (scrypt.rs:217), HKDF (hkdf.rs:112 is an RFC 5869 test vector digest selection). Quantum impact only via Grover (128-bit preimage margin) — not urgent; CNSA 2.0 prefers SHA-384 for national-security systems.
